thread:
megan: quick idea00000000when Dedicated pools hit sustained saturation, instead of full failover can we route affected tenants into a small 'quarantine' affinity pool on Hosted? goal: protect other Dedicated tenants and avoid cascade.
aditya: sounds promising. quarantine = small burst pool in Hosted with degraded SLO, right?
megan: yeah, relaxed latency plus tokenized telemetry so we can attribute costs.
courtney: observability is critical. if traffic moves to quarantine we must tag metrics (tenant.affinity=quarantine) and emit events to evals and billing. otherwise it hides in generic hosted numbers.
samir: KV/cache mismatch is the tricky bit. Dedicated has local prefix KV layout; moving mid-session to Hosted yields cold cache. Options: invalidate prefix on eviction, or emit a migration marker so hosted runtime can remap.
liz: ops/runbook: we need manual verbs (`rictl tenant quarantine <id>` / `rictl tenant restore <id>`) that also annotate the tenant manifest and surface in console.
megan: routing policy: probe-first (sample + ramp) vs immediate cutover. probe-first safer.
aditya: agree. propose reusing probe infra with affinity header opt-in. config example: ```quarantine_policy: mode: probe_first sample_rate: 0.05 hosted_qos_profile: "quarantine-low-priority" max_concurrent: 50```
courtney: telemetry hooks: emit `quarantine_start` + `quarantine_end` with reason (overload/noisy_neighbor/manual). tie to cost reports and UI state "Degraded - Quarantine".
samir: eviction tokens: Dedicated currently returns a short lease token. If we issue eviction->quarantine token, Hosted must accept it to resume KV context; otherwise token mismatch and duplicate model state. Recommend signed token envelope `migrate_v1::<base64>` both runtimes validate.
megan: token envelope sounds good. billing?
courtney: bill at hosted rates but show a "quarantine discount" (e.g., 0.8x) so customers aren't surprised.
srebot: ALERT (automated): a test run showed a 2.3x token cost increase on migration path due to cache misses. logs: https://logs.internal/xyz :rotating_light: 
liz: runbook draft: - detect Dedicated saturation -> autosuggest quarantine - run probe-first sample for 30s - if sample passes, migrate at 5% ramp every 10s - emit quarantine_start with reason - monitor latency/err_rate for 5m, if > threshold rollback to Dedicated
opsbot: CLI helpers: ```rictl tenant quarantine --id=acme --mode=probe_first --sample=0.05 rictl tenant restore --id=acme rictl quarantine-status --id=acme```
megan: action items: 1) aditya+samir spec token envelope+KV marker (PR by Thu EOD), 2) courtney add telemetry events+billing tag, 3) liz update runbook+CLI stubs, 4) megan write short RFC for quarantine affinity pool + QoS profiles. canary on internal test tenants first.
aditya: will prototype token envelope + probe config.
samir: will sketch KV marker flow.
courtney: drafting telemetry + billing mapping.
liz: updating runbook + cli stubs.
megan: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll sync Fri standup if needed.
